analysis.title: GS TMT TODAY 11.11.26
key_insights: US equity futures are higher premarket (Nasdaq +190bps, S&P +90bps, Russell +80bps) with tech leading globally (Korea +260bps, Japan +130bps, Euro Tech +160bps). The note attributes the move to better overnight neocloud earnings and better reported OpenAI revenue.
The note says investor positioning across Info Tech has been reset to multi-year lows ahead of a catalyst-rich stretch.

Premarket gains are broad across the AI stack: neoclouds (CRWV +17%, NBIS +11%), semis (AMD +7%, INTC +6%, NVDA +4%, AVGO +4.5%), industrial data center suppliers (BE +9%, VRT +6%) and memory (DRAM +8%, SNDK +8%, MU +6%).
NVDA's RSI ticked 24 on the prior day, the lowest since 2019, before the premarket bounce of about 4%.

Bloomberg, citing people familiar, reports OpenAI Q3 revenue (three months to September) reached $10B, up nearly 50% from Q2 and almost 3x year over year. Adjusted operating margin narrowed to -109% from -150%, and the company ended September with roughly $50B in annualized revenue.
A TSMC executive told the Nikkei Forum that demand for AI chips is 'insatiable'.

Bloomberg reports ByteDance plans to release a Muse-like AI assistant in the coming weeks to extend its lead in AI video. Co-founder Zhang Yiming told staff the goal is to close the gap with top US labs in as soon as three years.

GS economics said October CPI surprised meaningfully to the upside across several categories, the third month of worse inflation news. GS continues to expect a second 25bp hike in December and adds a third 25bp hike in March 2027. GS sees January as possible but March as more likely, because it expects softer November and December inflation reports followed by larger start-of-year price increases.
The US bond market is closed for Veterans Day after UST yields climbed steeply the prior day on the CPI print and hawkish Fed commentary.

GS expects ADI to deliver a solid fiscal Q4 with revenue guidance above the Street. Investors are expected to focus on industrial and automotive commentary, datacenter demand, and production capacity and input costs. GS views positioning as balanced and thinks the stock can move higher on a solid quarter.

Geopolitics: Trump said further strikes on Iran are unnecessary, but peace talks show little progress. Iran said it will not remove enriched nuclear material from the country and that any US attack would trigger strikes on US bases. WTI is +85bps at $86.80.

US telecom 3Q26: GS describes healthy, consistent competition that lets T, TMUS and VZ raise pricing and cut device subsidies. It flags possible seasonally higher promotions in 4Q26. Cable (CMCSA, CHTR) showed continued broadband pressure, and both announced cost savings in response to share loss and EBITDA declines.
Live Nation Investor Day (Nov 10) outlined $1,875M of incremental AOI opportunities, including a $925M AOI opportunity from Venue Nation growth.

Flex plans to spin off its datacenter business (CPI) as Axiom in 1QCY27. Flex targets raising the share of revenue from 6 target markets from ~24% in FY26 to ~30% in FY27 and 35-40% in FY29, with adjusted EBIT margin rising from ~5.8% pro-forma in FY27 to 7%+ in FY29. Axiom revenue is guided to a 20%+ CAGR over CY27-30 after >100% growth in CY27.

StubHub (STUB) Q3'26: GMS and adjusted EBITDA were ahead of the Street. Net leverage fell to 2.5x from 4.5x at FY25 after $100mm of additional debt repayment and maturities extended to 2033. TTM FCF was $192mm, affected by the timing of World Cup buyer collections and seller payments. GS is constructive.
iHeartMedia (IHRT): GS keeps a Sell and cuts its 12-month price target to $0.75 from $2.25 after 3Q26 missed on revenue and adjusted EBITDA and 4Q26 guidance came in below consensus.

tension_points.bull_case: Better neocloud earnings and OpenAI revenue ($10B quarterly, ~$50B annualized) are lifting the AI stack while Info Tech positioning sits at multi-year lows.
tension_points.bear_case: October CPI surprised to the upside for a third month, and GS now expects hikes in December and March 2027, with steep UST yield gains the prior day.
tension_points.what_invalidates: GS expects softer November and December inflation reports. Larger January price increases would instead bring a third hike earlier, in January.
